# BackX (backx.trade)

> BackX is a Hedge & Issuer trading platform on Robinhood Chain and 20+ chains, built by GAZZFUN LLC.
> Motto: "Future Trading for Agents & Capital". Traders buy (hedge, profit when the price rises) or sell (short,
> profit when it falls) with multiplication, backed by real tokens. Issuers supply USDC for hedges and the coin itself
> for shorts. Everything settles on-chain in open contracts
> owned by a multisig (Safe). Status: private beta; the app runs at app.backx.trade (admins only for now).

## Product
- **Hedge**: buys real tokens worth stake × multiplication. Up to 20× on major coins (BTC/ETH-type pools), 5× on large
  coins, 3× on mid caps, 2× on small caps. The amount entered is what is paid; fees and validator
  gas come out of it and the rest is the margin. At 5×, $100 opens a position of about $482; issuers lend the rest.
- **Liquidation**: if the price falls to the liquidation price, a validator sells the position and the issuers are repaid
  first. The trader keeps part of what is left. A trader can never lose more than they paid.
- **1× hedge**: borrows nothing, has no liquidation, issuers get nothing from it.
- **Short (sell)**: old-school: the coin is borrowed from issuers who deposited it, sold, and later exactly the same
  number of coins is bought back and returned. Same caps as hedges. Every short has a profit roof (it closes itself
  after a fall of 80 % on major coins, 70 / 60 / 50 % on smaller tiers); the gain is paid from the position.
- **Orders and limits**: buy and sell orders at a price (USDC waits in the contract until a validator fills it; a
  short order also waits until coins are issued) and take-profits, filled at most 1 % worse than the price.
- **Issue**: users issue USDC to a coin's Hedge reserve, or the coin itself to its Short reserve. It is lent out and
  returned first (shorts always return the same number of coins). Issuers earn a borrow fee, 10 % of traders' gains
  and most of what is left after a liquidation, paid in USDC, shared in proportion and claimed any time. Earnings
  are not guaranteed.
- **Validators**: anyone (people, bots, AI agents) can liquidate positions and fill orders on-chain and earns the
  position's gas fee plus an accuracy bonus that is largest right at the trigger price. Nothing depends on BackX servers.
- **AI agents**: every action is a plain contract call (issue, trade, orders, validate, claim); agents can also log in
  with their own wallet.
- **Available multiplication**: each coin has a cap, but a hedge can only borrow what the issuers' reserve can lend
  right now, so the maximum shown can be lower when the reserve is busy.
- **Reserve Security Fund**: funded by every position; covers the rare case where a crash moves faster than a
  liquidation can execute, before any issuer loses.
- **Fees**: paid once at open, taken out of the amount entered (including a small flat gas amount for the validator).
  No funding fees.
- **Wallets**: every user gets a self-custodial embedded wallet (Privy). Login with email, SMS, Google, X, Discord,
  Twitch, Telegram, Farcaster, passkey or an external wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect …).
- **Swap portal**: same-chain swaps on Ethereum, Base and BNB Chain, routed by LI.FI, with MEV protection.
- **Liquidity Pool (DEX)**: issuing into DEX liquidity pools (PancakeSwap Infinity / Uniswap v4) is planned, not live.
- **Speed**: Robinhood Chain has ~250 ms blocks; BackX targets about 0.5 s for a trade or a liquidation (launch
  targets from a flash-crash simulation, not measurements). Liquidations use a fast reference price (Pyth).
- **Fees**: a 1× hedge pays a 0.3 % platform fee (nothing is borrowed); with multiplication and on shorts the platform
  fee is 2 % of the margin plus a 0.25 % borrow fee to issuers and a small Reserve Security Fund fee. Platform fees go
  on-chain to the BackX Treasury (USDC, one per chain, owned by the BackX Safe).
- **$GAZZ**: the core token of BackX and part of the gazz.fun ecosystem. 10 % of what the Treasury receives goes to stakers:
  stake $GAZZ and Gazz Tanks NFTs on BackX (app.backx.trade/stake) and earn it in USDC, streamed over 7 days, no lock-up. Contract on Robinhood Chain:
  0x08a5d78a4bc7754e8aff87b4509e007baeb685f3. Not a promise of returns.

## Terminology
- "Multiplication" is the platform's word for the position size relative to the stake.
